name: Odawara Tsumugi
source: A high school girl with a strong sense of justice. Volunteered to judge new teachers because of her dislike of men, especially molesters. Willingly engages in embarrassing situations to both protect the younger girls and in an effort to disqualify the examinees but hides a dark past.
